notes.title: Single-byte XOR — LabCTF
notes.summary: Ciphertext didekripsi dengan kunci single-byte XOR 0x37. Hasilnya cocok dengan format yang diminta, dan XOR ulang menghasilkan ciphertext asli. Kandidat flag belum diverifikasi oleh checker remote.

candidates.basis: Perhitungan C1 menguji 256 kemungkinan kunci dan memperoleh plaintext berformat LabCTF{...} dengan kunci 0x37. XOR ulang mereproduksi ciphertext persis. Belum dikonfirmasi checker remote.

unresolved: Penerimaan flag oleh checker challenge belum diketahui.

computations.purpose: Brute-force all 256 single-byte XOR keys against the supplied hex; identify plaintext beginning LabCTF{ and verify by re-encoding.
computations.code: const m=input.message; const h=m.match(/Cipher hex:\s*([0-9a-f]+)/i)?.[1]; if(!h) return {error:"Cipher hex not found in input.message"}; const bytes=h.match(/../g).map(x=>parseInt(x,16)); const hits=[]; for(let k=0;k<256;k++){const p=bytes.map(b=>b^k); const s=String.fromCharCode(...p); if(s.startsWith("LabCTF{")&&s.endsWith("}")){hits.push({key:k,keyHex:k.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"),plaintext:s,reencodedHex:p.map(c=>(c^k).toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("")});}} return {extractedCipherHex:h,hits};

computations.code: const text = input.message + "\n" + input.context; const m = text.match(/YnoPGS\{grnz_pye_81\}/); if (!m) return {error:"Ciphertext persis tidak ditemukan", inspected:text.slice(0,500)}; const cipher=m[0]; const plain=cipher.replace(/[A-Za-z]/g,c=>String.fromCharCode((c>='a'&&c<='z'?97:65)+((c.charCodeAt(0)-(c>='a'&&c<='z'?97:65)+13)%26))); return {ciphertext:cipher,decoded:plain,method:"ROT13: setiap huruf digeser 13 posisi; angka, kurung kurawal, dan underscore tetap."};

computations.purpose: Ekstrak ciphertext persis dari sumber S1, terapkan ROT13, lalu verifikasi dengan ROT13 balik.
computations.code: const s=input.sources.find(x=>x.id==='S1'); const m=s.content.match(/ROT13 ciphertext ([^\.\s]+)/); if(!m) return {error:'ciphertext tidak ditemukan',sourceId:'S1'}; const ciphertext=m[1]; const rot=x=>x.replace(/[A-Za-z]/g,c=>String.fromCharCode((c<='Z'?65:97)+((c.charCodeAt(0)-(c<='Z'?65:97)+13)%26))); const plaintext=rot(ciphertext); return {sourceId:'S1',ciphertext,plaintext,roundTrip:rot(plaintext),verified:rot(plaintext)===ciphertext,flagFormatMatches:/^LabCTF\{[^}]+\}$/.test(plaintext)};
